dogecoin.text: Many investors seem to have reacted negatively towards Elon Musk highlighting Dogecoin as a “hustle” live on air. https://t.co/dWEf8t78AJ

Dogecoin retreated from a record earlier Saturday, declining during Elon Musk’s appearance on “Saturday Night Live,” where the billionaire jokingly called the digital asset “a hustle.”

Dogecoin reached a record above 73 cents before dropping as low as 51.4 cents during the show. https://t.co/q5N6X9uUXB

A senior manager at Goldman Sachs in London has quit the US investment bank after making millions from investing in Dogecoin, the joke crypto asset which has risen by more than 1,000% in value this year.

https://t.co/u7lsyXimWg https://t.co/jNJqCZORfy

The only big winner today is new meme coin SHIBA, with investors piling into the new Dogecoin rival. 

It’s up 43.05% over the last 24 hours. 

Are these joke coins good for publicity or are they ultimately bad for crypto?
